name: Tired
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of weariness and offers divine comfort and strength to those who are tired in spirit and body. The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves those with a contrite spirit, inviting His people to rest in Him and wait patiently without fear. God's presence provides enduring strength when flesh and heart fail, and He promises sweet rest and comfort to those who seek Him in their fatigue.
